question:
Read the following passage and answer the question that follows. Some words have been replaced by blanks numbered (1) to (5).

Passage:
When the young doctor first arrived in the remote village, she was ____(1)____ by the poverty and neglect she saw around her. Instead of complaining, she decided to roll up her ____(2)____ and get to work. She set ____(3)____ a small clinic in an abandoned shed and, devoted ____(4)____ her patients, often worked late into the night. Not only ____(5)____ she treat the sick, but she also taught the villagers the basics of hygiene.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
explanation: 'appalled' = भयभीत/स्तब्ध। amused = मनोरंजित; pleased = प्रसन्न; impressed = प्रभावित। Example: She was appalled by the filth in the street.
